name: numbers-speak
author: Vasyl Krupka
description: Interactive, bilingual (EN/UA) data visualizations built with D3.js, React and TypeScript — Ukraine and the world in numbers.

scripts.predev: npm run gen:catalog && npm run gen:previews && npm run sync:flags
scripts.prebuild: npm run gen:catalog && npm run gen:previews && npm run sync:flags
scripts.verify: npm run gen:catalog && npm run gen:previews && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run check:catalog && npm run check:data && npm run test && npm run smoke && npm run build

//catalog: One folder per visualization: src/viz/<id>/meta.ts + index.tsx. gen:catalog writes src/catalog/catalog.generated.ts (committed; predev/prebuild refresh it); check:catalog fails when it is stale. Card previews (S3-th): src/viz/<id>/preview.ts → gen:previews → src/catalog/previews.generated.json (committed; predev/prebuild refresh it; check:catalog guards staleness, coverage of published entries and the 12 kB gzip budget).
